components.name: secp256k1 ECDSA account/transaction signing supplied by go-ethereum geth — the crypto provider for the whole private net (version unpinned; README transcript shows Geth/v1.6.7-stable/go1.8.3, 2017). geth also supplies Keccak-256, Ethash PoW, RLPx secp256k1 ECDH, and keystore scrypt/AES-128-CTR. No post-quantum capability exists in any geth release

components.name: Keccak-256 — Ethereum identity-address derivation (address = last 20 bytes of keccak256(public key)); the three committed addresses are Keccak-256 outputs, preloaded via --preload=identities.js and pre-allocated in genesis.json. The same hash backs the keystore MAC field and runtime tx/block hashes
